messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: 503 rate spikes on /v1/generate from eu-west-1 (avg 12% errors) — attempts to auto-page failed (incidentbot returned 202).

maya: seeing same in logs, customer reports coming in. incidentbot posted in #incidents but didn't trigger paging.

jon: confirmed — message exists in channel but no pager sent. checked /integrations/pagerflow webhook -> 200 from our side.

luis: looks like pagerflow returned 202_ACCEPT but our webhook handler marked it as suppressed by debounce window. seeing: `suppression_reason=debounce_window` in trace.

maya: oh — debounce window was bumped in last deploy this morning (config flag `pager.debounce_ms=45000`). could be too long.

sara: for immediate mitigation can someone manually page the oncall? oncall is @jon-oncall.

jon: manual page sent (sms + phone). oncall acknowledged.

maya: thanks. I'm rolling a quick revert of the debounce change. patch queued.

luis: quick test to reproduce — run:`curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.internal/pagerflow -H 'X-Sign: test' -d '{"alert":"test","severity":"critical"}'`

maya: after revert, incidentbot retries for suppressed events every 15s — triggered a retry now. watching.

ops-bot: monitor: error-rate dropped to 3% in eu-west-1 (rolling), latency back to normal.

jon: confirmed paging now works on retry. root cause looks like aggressive debounce + a small timing regression in the webhook consumer.

sara: filing follow-up: need hard alerts when auto-page returns suppressed AND there are active customer errors. also add test harness for debounce edgecases.

luis: adding temporary probe to validate pagerflow responses end-to-end. will open PR with tests + revert diff.

maya: tagging infra + oncall for postmortem. impact: ~12% errors for ~10m, manual pages sent for two customers. no SSO or secret exposure.

jon: TY all. creating incident ticket with annotated timeline. :white_check_mark:
